entries.title: Psalms 79:1
segments: A psalm belonging to the same period as

; that is, the Babylonish invasion and captivity. 
 
For the sins of God's people, they are often brought into trouble; and they cannot obtain deliverance till, by repentance and reformation, they forsake their iniquities and turn to him.

entries.title: Psalms 79:4
segments: To our neighbors; to the surrounding heathen nations, who rejoiced in their calamities.

entries.title: Psalms 79:7
segments: Devoured Jacob; overcome the Israelites and slain them, or carried them away captive.

entries.title: Psalms 79:8
segments: The only hope of sinners is in the mercy of God through our Lord Jesus Christ, and to him they should look for pardon, salvation, and all needed good.

entries.title: Psalms 79:9
segments: Purge away our sins; forgive them for Christ's sake.

entries.title: Psalms 79:10
segments: Revenging of the blood of thy servants; punishing those who slew them.

entries.title: Psalms 79:12
segments: While the Lord delivers his servants, he brings deserved punishment upon his enemies.  To the one he is a kind and merciful shepherd, and to the other a consuming fire.
